items.title: 1.11 Network diagnostic tools aur commands (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 1.11 (PDF 17-18), paragraph for paragraph, the same code blocks, a reading of the output lines, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network diagnostic tools network ke masail dhoondne ke liye istemal hote hain. Yeh Internet aur network ke connections check karne mein madad dete hain. Yeh tools dikhate hain ke devices theek tarah baat kar sakte hain ya nahi. Commands command prompt ya terminal mein likhi jati hain. Is se sust ya toote hue connections pehchanne mein madad milti hai.

Network troubleshooting (masla dhoond kar theek karna) network ke masail dhoondne aur theek karne ke liye kiya jata hai. Is se connection aur raftar ke masle pakre jate hain. Troubleshooting mein cables, devices aur settings check hoti hain. Is se network ke band rehne ka waqt (downtime) aur ghaltiyan kam hoti hain. Is se baat-cheet hamwaar rehti hai. Sahi troubleshooting network ki performance behtar karti hai.

Ping command network connectivity (rabta) test karne ke liye istemal hoti hai. Yeh check karti hai ke koi device network par pohanch mein hai ya nahi. Ping doosre device ko chhote data packets bhejti hai (jaise Figure 1.16 mein). Yeh manzil se jawab aane ka waqt (response time) napti hai. Yeh command network mein deri (delay) pakarne mein madad deti hai. Internet connection check karne ke liye yeh aam istemal hoti hai.

Pinging google.com [142.250.190.14] with 32 bytes of data:
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=24ms TTL=118
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=26ms TTL=118
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118

blocks.text: Output ki har Reply line mein manzil ka IP address, packet ka size (32 bytes), milliseconds mein aane jane ka waqt (time) aur TTL (time to live: packet zyada se zyada kitne routers se guzar sakta hai) hota hai. Taqreeban 25 ms ke barabar waqt achhe connection ki nishani hain; "Request timed out" ka matlab hai ke jawab wapas nahi aaya.

blocks.alt: Host A, laptop jis ki screen par Ping 192.168.0.1 likha hai, aur Host B, server. ICMP Echo Request ka teer Host A se Host B tak jata hai, aur ICMP Echo Reply ka teer Host B se wapas Host A tak aata hai.

blocks.text: Do jaghon (locations) ke darmiyan packets ke raaste ka naqsha banayein.

Ipconfig Windows operating system mein istemal hoti hai. Ifconfig Linux aur macOS systems mein istemal hoti hai. Yeh commands network ki settings dikhati hain. Yeh IP address aur subnet mask dikhati hain. Yeh gateway aur network ki halat (status) bhi dikhati hain. Yeh commands network troubleshooting mein madad deti hain.

Telnet door se (remote) kisi device tak pohanchne ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh data encryption ke baghair bhejta hai. PuTTY remote login ka mashhoor tool hai. SSH remote access ka mehfooz tareeqa hai. SSH hifazat ke liye data ko encrypt karta hai. Yeh tools network devices sambhalne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Aik talib-e-ilm IP address se websites khol sakta hai lekin naam se nahi. Ghaliban kaun si service kharab hai, aur Windows par kaun si command computer ki IP settings dikhayegi?
blocks.explanation: Ghaliban DNS (naam ka tarjuma) kharab hai, kyunke connection khud kaam kar raha hai. Windows par ipconfig IP address, subnet mask aur default gateway dikhati hai.

items: Diagnostic tools network ke masail dhoondte hain; commands command prompt ya terminal par.
ping: device tak pohanch aur jawab ka waqt; har Reply line mein bytes, time aur TTL.
ipconfig (Windows) / ifconfig (Linux, macOS): IP settings; SSH: encrypted remote access, Telnet nahi.
